title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_kristallscherben_by_svea_lundberg_dko2z (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_kristallscherben_by_svea_lundberg_dko2z' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted machine. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious presence, as the attacker may have established persistent control.
